answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the tide of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The ripple lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the zenith is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
